about: Dylan's Resonance powers from CONTROL Resonant. Each row becomes a reusable quick item that costs FP (FP stands in for Resonance), borrowing an Elden Ring throwable's effect. A unique FP cost lets the mod tell which power was used so it can play that power's CONTROL Resonant sound.

rows.name: Resonance: Force Push
rows.info: Shove foes away with a pulse of resonance.
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A burst of force that throws enemies back and opens space.
Costs FP, which stands in for Resonance. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Offensive Shield
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A shell of resonance that blunts incoming blows.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Ignite
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A thrown spark of resonance that bursts into flame.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Inferno
rows.info: Ignite, grown into a roaring blaze.
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability, the fire path's upgrade.
A larger, hotter burst of flame.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Growth
rows.info: Seed a creeping affliction in your foes.
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A status burst that keeps eating at whatever it touches.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Barrage
rows.info: Loose a bolt of raw resonance at range.
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A fast ranged shot for fights you can't close.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

rows.name: Resonance: Remote Explosion
rows.info: Plant resonance and let it detonate.
rows.caption:
A Resonance ability.
A heavy charge that erupts where it lands.
Costs FP. Never runs out.

excluded.reason: Rotates the world in CONTROL Resonant's levels; there is no equivalent in Elden Ring's maps. (Elevate, Double Jump and Rush are in sheets/traversal.json.)
